scope: LOCAL_ONLY proxy take planning, frozen generation snapshots, formal video QC and atomic delivery selection

implementation.proxy_takes: GenerationWorkbench validates 1–8 explicit takes, derives one immutable Variant/Job per seed, and I2V preflight requires a current approved KEYFRAME; seed batch remains a read-only plan until explicit submit.
implementation.formal_generation: Submitted Variant jobs persist workflow/profile/model/manifest/seed/media approval snapshots and promote successful local artifacts as new immutable MediaVersions; exact replay rejects changed execution snapshots.
implementation.formal_review: Formal video machine QC now persists ffprobe-backed decode, dimensions, fps, duration and codec results under g6_formal_video_qc_v1; the immutable formal_video template separately requires action, identity, flicker and subtitle-safe-zone human checks.
implementation.batch_delivery: Formal selection preflight filters project-owned FORMAL versions and returns per-item blockers for approval, stale human review and integrity; commit validates the plan hash and writes the batch atomically without silent partial success.

required: Windows x64 real local model proxy/formal output with multiple approved-keyframe takes
formal video review across three viewports with human action/identity/flicker/safe-zone checks
multi-item delivery preflight against real approval and integrity drift

notes: Automated evidence uses isolated local fixtures only; no bundled model, upload or public runtime is implied.
